pli-tv-bu-vb-sk65:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk65:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū pallatthikāya nisinnassa dhammaṃ desenti…pe….
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk65:1.3.1: ‘‘Na pallatthikāya nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ desessāmīti sikkhā karaṇīyā’’ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk65:1.4: Na pallatthikāya nisinnassa agilānassa dhammo desetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-sk65:1.5: Yo anādariyaṃ paṭicca hatthapallatthikāya vā dussapallatthikāya vā nisinnassa agilānassa dhammaṃ deseti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
